{{Quote|Did we lose someone else's vote?''"<br />"''Senator Stonk, worried about public opinion. But, he wants us to know how very sorry he is.''"<br />"''<nowiki>'</nowiki>Sorry' doesn't get us votes.|[[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
'''Stonk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he retracted his vote from Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|proposal]] to stop the production of additional [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] out of concern for his "public opinion."
